summary: Riverside Orleigh Park car park in trees, homes 30 m or more away.
reasons: Park car park beside the river
Public asphalt car park, many cars present

best_section.where: Asphalt car park just north-west of the ring, at the end of the park access road

drivers.seclusion: Park, river and tree canopy surround it; the nearest houses are 30 m or more away beyond the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Asphalt access road leads straight in; marked car park bays with room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Park access road has light traffic; recreation users by day.
drivers.convention: Public no-fee car park with several cars parked; no signs mapped here.

flags: Low-lying: 4-6 m elevation beside the Brisbane River, flood-prone
Public park, possible time limits or closing hours unknown
Pin sits under trees; the real place is the car park about 28 m away
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy shades the car park most of the day, mainly from the east and south.
